description.en: Full-text index of every local DSH session: sessiongraph searches conversations across all workspaces, with a CJK bigram tokenizer so two-character Chinese terms match, and sessiongraph_index builds or refreshes the on-disk index.
description.zh: 本机全部 DSH 会话的全文索引：sessiongraph 跨工作区检索对话，用 CJK 双字分词让中文两字词也能命中；sessiongraph_index 负责构建与刷新磁盘索引。
